record_text:
Key points.
Rainwater harvesting. Roofs catch rain into barrels or cisterns for irrigation and more.

In depth.
Catch: gutters feed first-flush diverters that skip the dirty first runoff. Store: sealed barrels or cisterns keep water clean and mosquito-free. Use: irrigation first; potable use needs treatment and local code compliance.
